scientific_integrity: The proof uses the exact Weibull survival function, exact Gamma-function moment formulas, and a controlled Stirling expansion. Finite high-precision computations are supplementary regression checks, not evidence for the infinite asymptotic. The originality comparison distinguishes the published qualitative zero result from the new multiplicative prefactor and threshold-ratio profile.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a small-shape asymptotic for fixed positive standardized thresholds, locally uniform only on compact subsets of the positive threshold axis. It does not cover thresholds varying to zero or infinity with the shape parameter and does not optimize a convergence rate over all Weibull shapes.
title: A hidden power-law threshold profile in small-shape Weibull anti-concentration
